metadata.title: On the index of two-dimensional elliptic end-periodic operators
metadata.abstract: This paper investigates the index problem for elliptic end-periodic differential operators on a two-dimensional manifold with a cylindrical end. We define the topological index as the sum of the contribution of the interior symbol, expressed by an Atiyah--Singer type integral, and the contribution of the limit operator, expressed in terms of the Melrose type eta-invariant and a correction term that depends on the lower order terms of the limit operator. We prove the homotopy invariance of the topological index, which allows us to reduce the original problem to the study of operators of a simpler form by employing $K$-theoretic methods.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 二维椭圆端周期算子的拓扑指标
analysis.workSummary: 在带圆柱端的二维流形上，把拓扑指标定义为内部符号的Atiyah–Singer型积分，加极限算子的Melrose型eta及依低阶项的修正。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明该拓扑指标的同伦不变性，并据此归约至较简单形式的算子。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确宣称完整解析指标等于拓扑指标，不能把归约结果补成未写出的指标定理。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。16页PDF完整提取，全文候选及点写AI、任意断行模型名型号、HyProver/Hunyuan/Danus补检未观察到生成式AI实际使用声明。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何分析中的非紧指标理论工具。
